name: Tranquil Tempest
source:
Orphaned and adrift, Juni (nameable MC) lives a quiet life in her cramped apartment, days consumed by the world of Trankill, a virtual fighting game that's both her refuge and livelihood. Her only anchor is her best friend, Riley. It's not much, still leagues beyond the hard life she's known as a Silen refugee in the past.  

But when a high-stakes Trankill tournament sweeps her up into a conspiracy, she has to decide: keep drifting where life takes her, or grab the wheel and steer through the tempest ahead.  

[From [url=https://selavi.itch.io/tranquil-tempest]Itch.io[/url]]
